title: No init() in providers
description: Providers must not use init() for registration to ensure a clear and explicit registration flow.
fix: Use the explicit Register(...) function within the designated registration files (e.g., providers/all/all.go).

title: Orchestrators must not import concrete providers
description: Orchestrators must depend only on 'core' interfaces, not on concrete provider implementations in 'internal/providers'. This maintains separation of concerns.
fix: Remove any imports from 'internal/providers' and rely on the dependency injection mechanism to provide components.

title: LLM providers must not create clients directly
description: LLM providers should not construct their own HTTP or API clients (e.g., openai.New..., http.Client{}). They must receive them via dependency injection.
fix: Request the client from the dependency injection system (diapi.Builder) instead of creating it directly.

title: No runtime type assertions on concrete providers
description: Avoid runtime type assertions on concrete provider types. Use the 'core' and 'diapi' interfaces for dependency resolution.
fix: Refactor to use interfaces from 'core/diapi' to access components and their methods.

title: Orchestrator must correctly drain resource closers
description: The orchestrator's Close() method must correctly iterate over and execute all registered ResourceCloser functions to prevent resource leaks.
fix: Ensure the Close() method on the orchestrator implementation properly calls the collected ResourceCloser functions.

title: Hybrid retriever must not hard-code RRF-K or sub-retrievers
description: The hybrid retriever should not have hard-coded values for the RRF-K constant or the names of its sub-retrievers.
fix: These values must be exposed as configurable fields in the HybridOptions struct.

title: Detect dead/unimported packages
description: Code and packages that are not imported or used by other parts of the application should be identified and removed to reduce maintenance overhead.
fix: Remove the unused package or integrate it into the application.

title: Core package dependency violations
description: The 'core' package must not import 'internal/providers', 'pipeline', or the root 'builder'.
fix: Remove the invalid import statements to maintain the core's independence.
